verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Secure Data Sharing, which shares selected database objects between Snowflake accounts with no data copied. That lets third-party data be queried in place alongside your own, which covers the core of in-platform enrichment. However, nothing in the pack mentions a marketplace or listing catalog for discovering third-party datasets. Missing for 10: any evidence of a marketplace or listings, discovery and browsing of third-party providers, analyst-facing enrichment workflow docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
